senses.gloss: condition of a deserted wife, disability to remarry, v. עָגַן.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 3a:6">Gitt. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 88a:11">Yeb. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>משום ע׳ אקילו וכ׳</he> in order to prevent the eventuality of ‘widowhood in life’, the Rabbis have made lenient rules for her (as regards testimony to her husband’s death); a. e.
